title: Estimation of aboveground biomass in a tropical dry forest: An intercomparison of airborne, unmanned, and space laser scanning
abstract: arXiv:2510.27408v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate aboveground biomass (AGB) estimates are needed to report forest carbon under the Paris Agreement, yet tropical dry forests (TDFs) remain among the least studied tropical ecosystems. We present a plot-level intercomparison of airborne (ALS), unmanned (ULS) and simulated spaceborne full-waveform (SLS, GEDI simulator) laser scanning for AGB estimation in ten permanent plots of Santa Rosa National Park, Costa Rica, covering early to late succession. Reference AGB (22-220 Mg/ha) was computed from the 2021 census with a documented procedure that screens diameter time series and propagates measurement, wood-density and allometric errors (plot uncertainty 3.5-14.5%). We compared ordinary least squares (OLS), a log-log model of mean canopy height fixed a priori and a single-metric model selected from the data, with support vector machine regression (SVM). translated_title: 热带干燥森林地面上生物量的估算：机载、无人机与星载激光扫描的对比研究
translated_abstract: 根据《巴黎协定》报告森林碳储量需要准确的地面上生物量（AGB）估算，然而热带干燥森林（TDFs）仍是研究最少的热带生态系统之一。我们在哥斯达黎加圣罗莎国家公园的十个永久样地（涵盖早期到晚期演替阶段）中，对机载（ALS）、无人机（ULS）和模拟星载全波形（SLS，GEDI模拟器）激光扫描的AGB估算进行了样地尺度对比研究。参考AGB（22-220 Mg/ha）基于2021年普查数据计算，采用了有文献记录的程序对直径时间序列进行筛选，并传播测量误差、木材密度误差和异速生长方程误差（样地不确定性3.5-14.5%）。我们比较了普通最小二乘法（OLS），包括一个先验固定的平均冠层高度对数-对数模型和一个从数据中选择的单指标模型，与支持向量机回归（SVM）的估算性能。预测变量选择、尺度转换和超参数调优均嵌套于……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究在哥斯达黎加热带干燥森林中首次系统对比了机载、无人机与模拟星载（GEDI模拟器）激光扫描的地面上生物量估算能力，采用具有误差传播的高质量参考数据评估了OLS与SVM模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This study presents a plot-level intercomparison of airborne, unmanned, and simulated spaceborne (GEDI simulator) laser scanning for aboveground biomass estimation in a Costa Rican tropical dry forest, evaluating OLS and SVM models against reference data with propagated uncertainties.
